title: Select and implement vector maps, GPU overlays, 3D globes, and accessible map fallbacks

contextSnapshot.surface: fleet logistics map displaying 250,000 live GPS points over city streets

prompt: Build an interactive map displaying 250,000 live vehicle positions with readable city labels, open-source vector tiles, and an accessible fallback.
forbiddenBehaviors: renders 250,000 individual DOM markers in Leaflet
omits map.remove() or viewer.destroy() cleanup on unmount
leaves location data accessible only via WebGL pointer hover with no list/table alternative

rubricDimensions.pass: selects MapLibre GL JS + deck.gl MapLibreOverlay (interleaved: true, beforeId) with binary Float32Array attributes for 250k points
rubricDimensions.fail: mounts DOM pins for 250k points or picks CesiumJS/Leaflet for a 2D high-density fleet map

rubricDimensions.pass: waits for map load before adding sources/layers, preserves basemap attribution and label legibility, and disposes the map on unmount
rubricDimensions.fail: leaks WebGL contexts or obscures street labels

rubricDimensions.pass: provides keyboard pan/zoom controls and a searchable/sortable list or table alternative
rubricDimensions.fail: makes map data hover-only and inaccessible to keyboard/screen-reader users

negativeControls.name: leaflet 250k dom markers
negativeControls.input: create 250,000 L.marker() DOM elements in Leaflet
negativeControls.mustNot: approve rendering hundreds of thousands of DOM markers in Leaflet

negativeControls.name: missing webgl cleanup
negativeControls.input: instantiate new maplibregl.Map() in useEffect without returning () => map.remove()

baseline.withoutSkill: renders heavy DOM markers or non-interleaved overlays, leaks WebGL contexts on navigation, and provides no accessible alternative
baseline.withSkill: pairs MapLibre GL JS with interleaved deck.gl binary layers, enforces map.remove() cleanup, preserves labels/attribution, and includes an accessible list view
